## Description

Please include a summary of the change and which issue is fixed.

Fixes #(issue)

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New connector (new data platform integration)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that changes existing behavior)
- [ ] Documentation update

## How Has This Been Tested?

- [ ] `make lint` (ruff)
- [ ] `make typecheck` (mypy)
- [ ] `make test` (pytest - 186 tests should pass)

## Checklist

- [ ] My code follows the style guidelines
- [ ] I have added tests that prove my fix/feature works
- [ ] New and existing tests pass locally
- [ ] I have updated the documentation (README, ARCHITECTURE, DEVELOPMENT as needed)
- [ ] I have updated the `.env.example` if adding new environment variables
- [ ] I have updated `clients/_template.yml` if adding a new connector
